old_caption: The video captures a dramatic scene of a rocket launch at sunset. The sky is painted with hues of orange and pink, reflecting beautifully on the water below. A large crowd of people, silhouetted against the vibrant backdrop, watches intently as the rocket ascends into the sky. The rocket's bright flame and smoke trail are clearly visible, creating a stark contrast against the softer colors of the sunset. As the rocket climbs higher, the camera pans slightly to the right, revealing more of the audience and a glimpse of a car parked nearby. The overall atmosphere is one of excitement and awe as the crowd observes the impressive display of technology and engineering.

caption: The video captures a crowd of silhouetted spectators in the foreground watching a brilliant orange-white flame rising at the horizon over water. The light casts a dome-shaped halo across the sky and a bright vertical reflection on the water, while a thin structure sits on the distant right edge. The flame plume flickers and reshapes, a small bright nub at its upper-left edge shifting and a faint vertical wisp trailing above it before vanishing into the glow. As the clip continues, the brightness surges and the narrow plume expands into a broad, rounded mass, enlarging the halo and intensifying the water reflection. The scene drifts leftward as the camera pans right, revealing more spectators along the right edge. The fireball remains luminous and active through the final frame.
